title: Caribbean Adventure (sample)
notes: Family trip; keep the tone warm and simple.
text:
=== Page 1 ===

CARIBBEAN ADVENTURE — 4 DAYS / 3 NIGHTS
Client: The Morgan family (2 adults, 2 children)
Travel dates: 18–21 September 2026

Day 1 — Arrival in San José and flight to Limón
Meet and greet at Juan Santamaría International Airport. Domestic flight with Sansa to Limón (35 min).
Private transfer to Puerto Viejo (1 h). Check-in at Shawandha Lodge, tepee bungalow, breakfast included.

Day 2 — Cahuita National Park
Guided walk along the coastal trail with a naturalist guide. Sloths, howler monkeys, raccoons.
Snorkelling at Punta Cahuita weather permitting. Lunch at a local soda. Afternoon at leisure.

=== Page 2 ===

Day 3 — Chocolate and Manzanillo
Morning visit to a family-run cacao farm: bean to bar with tasting.
Afternoon at Manzanillo wildlife refuge, walk to Punta Mona beach. Dinner at Koki Beach.

Day 4 — Return
Breakfast, private transfer to Limón airport, flight to San José, connection to international flight.

HOTEL OPTIONS
Shawandha Lodge, Playa Chiquita — tepee bungalow — from USD 210 per night
Le Caméléon, Cocles — deluxe room — from USD 290 per night
Hotel Banana Azul, Playa Negra — ocean view — from USD 180 per night

=== Page 3 ===

INCLUDED
3 nights accommodation with breakfast; domestic flights San José–Limón–San José; all private transfers; guided Cahuita National Park walk; chocolate farm tour; bilingual guide.

NOT INCLUDED
International flights; travel insurance; meals not mentioned; gratuities.

PRICE
From USD 1,850 per adult, USD 980 per child (4–11), based on double occupancy.
